interface.longDescription: v1tamins packages reusable AI development skills for reviewing code, writing tests, preparing PRs, improving documentation, debugging failures, and keeping agent workflows consistent across projects. Plugin-distributed skills use a v1- prefix to avoid collisions with other public skills.
